shipping.question: How fast will my laptop arrive?
shipping.answer: Orders placed on working days before 17:00 usually arrive the next working day. We ship with PostNL within the Netherlands for € 4.95.

returns.question: Can I return my laptop?
returns.answer: Yes. You have a 14-day cooling-off period from the day you receive the laptop. Request a return from your account or the returns page and you'll be refunded within 14 days.

tracking.question: How can I track my order?
tracking.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with a tracking code. You can also check the status any time under My Orders.

in3.question: Can I pay in 3 installments?
in3.answer: Yes. With in3 you pay in three equal, interest-free installments: the first at checkout via iDEAL, the other two within 30 and 60 days. Available for orders within the allowed amount, for customers in the Netherlands.
